description: An authenticated, opt-in companion app can send normalized navigation guidance over BLE or Wi-Fi. No claim of access to Google Maps or Apple Maps UI state.
transport: BLE GATT custom service OR mutually authenticated HTTPS/WebSocket over Wi-Fi
security: Design must add pairing/authentication, integrity/replay defense, and source timeout before production.
road_signs: Do not infer camera-recognized regulatory signs from turns or route geometry; a map-based limit is separately labeled as a map estimate.
